skill.name: reasoningbank-with-agentdb
skill.description: Build ReasoningBank-style adaptive memory with AgentDB for agent trajectories, verdicts, memory distillation, and similarity retrieval.
skill.summary: Use AgentDB to build adaptive agent memory for ReasoningBank workflows.
skill.author: DNYoussef

security_audit.summary: Most Ruby or shell backtick alerts are false positives from Markdown fences and TypeScript template literals. Confirmed risks remain for unpinned AgentDB CLI execution, MCP setup, and hidden SQLite memory files that can contain sensitive agent history. No prompt injection or deliberate network exfiltration evidence was found.

remediation.issue: Unpinned AgentDB CLI execution and MCP registration
remediation.suggestion: Replace agentdb@latest with a pinned version and require explicit user review before adding any MCP server configuration.

remediation.issue: Hidden SQLite memory databases can store sensitive task history
remediation.suggestion: Document allowed data types, add .gitignore guidance, and recommend encryption or access controls for .agentdb and .swarm paths.

remediation.issue: Migration and export commands can copy sensitive memories
remediation.suggestion: Add backup handling guidance, redaction steps, and validation commands that avoid verbose disclosure of private memory content.

content.user_title: Build Adaptive Agent Memory with AgentDB
content.value_statement: Self-learning agents need durable memory to compare decisions and improve outcomes. This skill shows AgentDB patterns for trajectories, judgments, distillation, and retrieval.
actual_capabilities: Initialize an AgentDB-backed ReasoningBank database from documented CLI steps.
Show TypeScript examples for storing experiences, trajectories, and distilled patterns.
Demonstrate similarity retrieval, verdict judgment, and context synthesis workflows.
Describe memory optimization, experience curation, and multi-domain transfer patterns.
Provide migration and troubleshooting guidance for legacy ReasoningBank memory files.
limitations: Requires Node.js 18 or later and a compatible AgentDB package.
Does not provide production encryption, access control, or backup policy code.
Performance claims should be validated in the target environment.
Examples are implementation patterns, not a complete application.

use_cases.title: Add Learning Memory to Agents
use_cases.description: Create a local memory layer that stores successful and failed decisions for later retrieval.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Agent Trajectories
use_cases.description: Compare a new task path with similar prior outcomes before accepting an automated verdict.

use_cases.title: Migrate Legacy Reasoning Data
use_cases.description: Move existing ReasoningBank memories into an AgentDB-backed workflow with validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Plan the First Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: I am building a self-learning agent for [domain]. Guide me through creating an AgentDB-backed ReasoningBank store with prerequisites and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Store Agent Experiences
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a ReasoningBank memory flow for [agent task]. Include trajectory fields, success metrics, confidence scoring, and retrieval criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Judge a New Trajectory
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me compare this new trajectory against stored ReasoningBank memories. Recommend verdict logic, confidence thresholds, and review safeguards.

prompt_templates.title: Govern a Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a migration plan from legacy ReasoningBank memory to AgentDB. Include validation, rollback, sensitive data handling, and version pinning.

output_examples.input: Set up adaptive memory for a code review agent.
output_examples.output: A setup plan with prerequisites, database location, memory domains, first trajectory fields, and a validation checklist.

output_examples.input: Judge whether an optimization trajectory succeeded.
output_examples.output: A verdict approach using similar memories, success-rate thresholds, confidence scoring, and manual review triggers.

output_examples.input: Migrate an existing memory database safely.
output_examples.output: A migration checklist covering backups, version pinning, path review, validation statistics, and sensitive data controls.

best_practices: Pin AgentDB package versions and review every CLI command before running it.
Keep memory databases out of source control and protect backups with access controls.
Start with narrow domains and measure retrieval quality before automated decisions.
anti_patterns: Running latest-version package commands without review or version pinning.
Storing credentials, private customer data, or secrets in agent memories.
Treating similarity scores as final truth without evaluation or human review.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps build adaptive memory workflows for agents using ReasoningBank concepts and AgentDB storage.

faq.question: Does it run AgentDB automatically?
faq.answer: No. It documents commands and code patterns that a user or agent may choose to run.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill references AgentDB MCP integration for Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: What data should be stored?
faq.answer: Store task context, actions, outcomes, metrics, and confidence values. Avoid secrets and regulated personal data.

faq.question: Is it production ready by itself?
faq.answer: No. Add version pinning, access controls, encryption, backups, and monitoring for production use.

faq.question: Who should use it?
faq.answer: It fits developers building agent memory, trajectory review, or experience replay systems.
